name: fee-platform
description: Multi-tenant fee collection and payment management platform

scripts.test: npm run test:tenant-schema && turbo run test
scripts.test:tenant-schema: node scripts/generate-composite-tenant-constraints.mjs --check && node --test scripts/generate-composite-tenant-constraints.spec.mjs scripts/tenant-relation-schema-validator.spec.mjs scripts/tenant-relation-preflight.spec.mjs scripts/concurrent-index-runner.spec.mjs scripts/generate-concurrent-index-plan.spec.mjs scripts/deploy-staged-migrations.spec.mjs scripts/compose-database-target.spec.mjs scripts/verify-compose-neon-target.spec.mjs scripts/provision-database-roles.spec.mjs scripts/database-acl-manifest.spec.mjs scripts/verified-webhook-dedupe-migration.spec.mjs
scripts.docker:up: node scripts/verify-compose-neon-target.mjs --env-file .env --compose-file docker-compose.yml && docker compose --env-file .env --project-directory . up --build -d
scripts.docker:watch: node scripts/verify-compose-neon-target.mjs --env-file .env --compose-file docker-compose.yml && docker compose --env-file .env --project-directory . up --build --watch
scripts.clean: turbo run clean && node scripts/clean-workspace.mjs node_modules-cache
